config.notes: Connects to Grafana Cloud's hosted MCP server. GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN holds a Grafana service account token (sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header). Replace <https://your-instance.grafana.net> with your Grafana Cloud instance URL (sent in the X-Grafana-URL header). For self-managed Grafana, switch to the Docker-based local server: command 'docker', args ['run','-i','--rm','-e','GRAFANA_URL','-e','GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN','docker.io/grafana/mcp-grafana:latest'], env with GRAFANA_URL and GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.
